articleTitle: An Intellegent Traffic Control Prototype for Smooth Vehicular Flow based on FX5U-32MT PLC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Without the widespread use of computers, today’s control flows would be inconceivable. This paper outlines about using a PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) to operate real-time adaptive traffic lights, and design a 4-way road intersection with appropriate signalling and implementation of an intellectual traffic light controlling module to meet the needs. For the hardware execution of this work, FX5U-32MT PLC from IQF MITSUBISHI SERIES is used. The ladder logic program of GXWORKS3 was utilized to design the system on GTDesigner3 that is connected with GOT2000 main screen hardware panel. In a PLC simulation environment, the system was developed to assess traffic throughput in order to prevent or relieve prevailing congestion problems. The GT Designer3 configuration software was used to formulate a secluded traffic light monitoring system at the crossing point, which regulated traffic lights in real-time with much higher effectiveness. Around the same instant, the configuration picture allows us to modify the conditions of the traffic lights. Following the dissemination of information, choices on rescheduling and sequencing are made in a coordinated manner.

articleTitle: Frequency Analysis of Ring Oscillator at Different Technology Node
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: This paper deals with the design and analysis of the frequency of ring oscillators using the CMOS 45nm, 32nm, 22nm in a Symica simulation tool. A Ring Oscillator is an effective device made up of an odd number of NOT gates and its output runs between two levels of power standing up and down. There are many challenges ahead while designing a CMOS ring oscillator that can be delay, sound, and glitches. CMOS is the technology of choice for several applications, low-power CMOS oscillators are in high demand. The frequency of a CMOS ring oscillator was measured using waveform time zones for five, seven, and nine phases. This aids in the comparison of ring oscillators at various technology nodes and it is observed that the frequency is found to be maximum at a five-stage ring oscillator in each case i.e. 12.97GHz at 45 nm, 8.25GHz at 32 nm, 4.74GHz at 22 nm.

articleTitle: Advancement of Industrial Automation in Integration with Robotics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The architectures of the majority of existing autonomous robots are decomposed into small control systems or conduct. Although this division has many advantages, it raises the issue of coordinating implementation to achieve global coherence among various unit Comportement. The goal of autonomous robotics is to create physical structures that perform useful tasks in actual and unmodified environments without human intervention. That is, not directly in the environments for which the robot was designed. The high level of insecurity is a major issue for autonomous robotics. This is how real-world environments are described. These environments cannot be known precisely and completely in advance: Typically, the precise location of individuals and objects cannot be known.

articleTitle: Review on FIR Filters Using Different Adders and Multipliers Based on Vedic Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: A comparative study of Adders, multipliers and different combination of FIR Filters taken from different sources. FIR Filter designed by using different block which are Adders, Multipliers, and Delay elements. Digital multipliers are mostly used in designing new gadgets, and have many other applications in digital signal processing. FIR Filters are easy to design and are less power consuming. [1] This paper consist of several adders and multiplier like Ripple carry adder, Carry Look Ahead Adder, Han Carlson Adder, Dadda Multiplier, Booth Multiplier, and Vedic Multiplier etc. [2] The focus in this paper is on the parameter of adders, Multiplier and Fir Filters such as Power, LUT utilization, area and delay to find out an efficient FIR Filters with Vedic Mathematics concept. Among these multipliers Vedic Multiplier is the high speed and low power consuming multiplier.

Author Keywords: Adders (RCA, CSA, Kogge-stone, HAN-Carlson) MAC unit
UT sutra Vedic real multiplier / complex-FP and filters

articleTitle: A Secure Fog Computing Architecture for IoT Based Smart Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Nowadays, Fog computing is the hottest topic in the field of cloud computing and the internet of things. Fog Computing is a technology to enhance the power of cloud computing when transferring real-time data in IoT applications. In this paper, we discussed the enhancement of Fog Computing in the field of IoT. Now in the present day, we use cloud everywhere in our life to store a huge amount of data for business and personal purposes. In the cloud, we have security mechanisms like identity, authentication, password policies but not much enough for our security terms and conditions and cloud takes more time to process real time data. Somewhere or somehow our data security is made up of the high decryption technologies or the hacking issues, so we have come up with a new technology named Fog Computing which is used for security and protection purposes mainly focusing on fog processing. By the way, Cloud and Fog are almost the same things but the Fog will remain the dominating one because it is the extended features of cloud computing. IoT is the most growing technology used to process real time data like running software, home appliances, sensors, systems, and many other network-based applications to communicate with data and decrease human effort. For secure and fast communication between IoT devices and fog component, we proposed a secure real-time approach for smart manufacturing.

articleTitle: A Read Stability Enhanced, Temperature Tolerant 8T SRAM Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: In this paper, the performance of 6T, 9T-1, and 9T-2 SRAM bit cells designs are analyzed and then compared with the proposed 8T bit cell. The comparisons are done taking into consideration - hold, read, write static margins, and leakage current. The cells are designed for 90nm technology node and the simulations are performed at power supply of 1 V at room temperature, 27 °C. The hold static and read static noise margins obtained for the proposed cell are 0.423 V and 0.41 V respectively. Whereas, its write margin is 0.365 mV. To affirm the performance of the bit cells under varying temperature conditions, the performance of the cells is evaluated for a range of -10 °C to 110 °C. For the temperature variation analysis, the hold and read static noise margin varies by 0.23 mV/°C and 0.094 mV/°C respectively. While for the leakage current analysis, the proposed 8T SRAM bit cell delivers the best performance with the value of 2.15 nA.

articleTitle: Feasibility of Supercritical Hydrogen for cooling Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES) Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Electrical Power storage is an integral part of the power generation industry. In this context, superconductors based energy storage devices such as Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage Devices (SMES) have been invented which proved to be a milestone in power generation sector. However, these superconducting devices suffered with the issues such as AC losses and thermal losses which deteriorates the performance of energy storage phenomenon. Moreover, these losses also results in increased use of cryogenic fluids which are utilized to maintain the superconductivity of superconductors. Therefore, in the context of efficient cooling strategies for superconducting based energy storage devices, use of commercially available and thermally stable cryogenic fluid is inevitable. In the present work, supercritical hydrogen (SCH) as a coolant was proposed and thermo physical properties of SCH, which affects its operational capabilities, were studied. Graphs were plotted for density, viscosity, thermal conductivity and specific heat of SCH for various temperature and pressures and it was observed that the temperature rise resulted in tangible changes in these properties. In addition to this, correlations for thermo physical properties were also formulated which could further be used for research and development of SMES devices. Uniform temperature distribution is expected with the use of SCH in SMES devices which accentuates the performance of the device.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Brain Tumor MRI Images using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Tumor cells are a type of cell that grows outside of the normal forces that regulate development. Consistently, in tumor in brain is an emergency case, which is leading to death in many humans. Each year, approximately 6 lakh people in India are diagnosed with a brain tumor. Most common effect way to diagnose tumor is Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI). Thus, the aim of our work is to automatically detect brain tumor MRI images using deep learning techniques. The image was preprocessed, and by using a filtering method, which eliminated as much unnecessary noise as possible to aid better segmentation. The wavelet transform used a discrete model & principal component analysis, which will extract features. Comparison of machine learning algorithm with deep learning, which is done by using CNN (UNet).

articleTitle: Digital Image Steganography
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Various applications have various prerequisites of the steganography strategy utilized. As an example, a couple of applications may require outright imperceptibility of the restricted data, while others require a much bigger mystery message to be covered up. During this venture named “Image Steganography”, we’ve zeroed in on least huge piece change methods of spatial area. We’ve broke down and analyzed the variations of this calculation regarding viability and concealing limit. Adequacy of the calculation is estimated by client assessments deciding so, all things considered modification to the photographs got evident.

articleTitle: Different Current Mirror Topologies at Multiple Technology Nodes: Performance Comparison and Parameters Extraction
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: In this paper, different current mirror topologies are realized and analyzed using MOSFET and FinFET devices and compared their parameters. The main aim is to seek the performance of FinFET in analog circuits. FinFET current mirrors are realized with the basic topologies i.e. Simple current mirror, Wilson current mirror, Improved Wilson current mirror, and Cascode current mirror along with 180 nm, 90 nm, 45 nm, and 18 nm technology nodes using the Cadence Virtuoso Simulation tool. FinFET current mirror achieves large output resistance of 293 M$\Omega$ in Cascode connection due to its small channel length at low current whereas a low compliance voltage of 0.5 V is obtained at 90 nm technology in Simple current mirror. While interestingly, mirroring accuracy is observed better in Simple current mirror structure and the percentage error ratio is found lowest in Cascode current mirror structure at 180 nm technology nodes.

articleTitle: Design & Comparison of 32-bit CSLA with Hybrid Logic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Adders are used as a basic building element in a variety of computing units and processors. Carry select adder (CSLA) comes under one of the simplest and fastest multi-bit adders. In this study, we examine the results of designing CSLA utilizing two logic systems: CMOS and hybrid logic. Area and power are two critical issues in digital circuit design and synthesis of VLSI circuits, both of which depend on various parameters. The design of the proposed CSLA consists of Ripple Carry Adder (RCA), Binary Excess-1 converter (BEC), and 10:5 MUX. The circuits of XOR/XNOR, Full Adder, and proposed XOR/XNOR-based 32-bit CSLA are explored with hybrid logic. Unlike traditional CMOS-based CSLA, the proposed hybrid CSLA has an optimized low power and delay up to 7.9 μW and 0.01860 ns respectively. Furthermore, the transistor count is reduced to 1166, resulting in a reduction in size. The simulations have been done on cadence virtuoso and their performance parameters like transistor count, power, and delay are analysed. Technology Models of 45 nm are used to perform simulation results that show the circuit proposed with hybrid logic has superior speed and power against other circuits’ designs.

articleTitle: Study of Decentralized Database Network using concepts of Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The data stored in traditional database systems are vulnerable to attacks even with the existence of certain levels of security. In order to overcome such drawbacks, a dynamic database network is created between individual nodes. Instead of storing data in a static database, information is regulated among a specific inter related database nodes which significantly enhances the security of confidential data. The dynamic nature of the database network makes the data less stagnant at a particular node for a long period of time since the data is constantly circulated within several other nodes involved in the network. While the static form of storage of data provides a basic level of protection from intruders, the dynamic storage of information increases the complexity of combinations involved to track the necessary data since the algorithm constantly relocates the presence of data in each node.

articleTitle: MOMEDA Model Based Variational Mode Decomposition for Pelton Wheel Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The identification of fault frequency is a vital step in fault diagnosis. For this purpose, variational mode decomposition (VMD) is being used widely as it has ability to represent the signal in Time-frequency domain. The VMD, on the other hand, often fails to analyse non-stationary signals with low-frequency noises. In this paper, a multipoint optimal minimum entropy deconvolution adjusted (MOMEDA) in combination with VMD is applied to enhance the performance of defect detection in the presence of low-frequency noises. Study has been made on bucket defects in Pelton wheel. Initially, the raw vibration signal is decomposed using VMD into set of modes. Second, the MOMEDA model is used to purify each mode by reducing low-frequency noise interference. A purified signal is reconstructed from the modes processed by MOMEDA. In the end, Hilbert envelop spectrum is extracted, which demodulates the purified signal and helps in determining the fault frequency. The same is verified from the theoretical faulty feature frequency of the turbine bucket. Performance of the proposed method in extracting fault frequency accurately is also compared with other two models: a) MOMEDA model with ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) and b) MOMEDA model with complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN). The comparison results proved the efficacy and superiority of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Multipoint optimal minimum entropy deconvolution adjusted (MOMEDA)

articleTitle: Agri-Bot: IoT Based Unmanned Smart Vehicle for Multiple Agriculture Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The agricultural industry, particularly in India, is the most underdeveloped sector in the present era. So in addition to advancements in technology, new technology must be used in the agricultural industry to assist farmers and the agriculture sector. So we developed the Agri-Bot, an autonomous smart agriculture robot or vehicle that can conduct a variety of agricultural tasks such as planting, plowing, and fertilizer spreading, and harvesting without the need for a human operator. The robot known as automated agricultural equipment, Agri-Bot, is capable of plowing, sowing, and spreading fertilizer across a whole field only by using the length and width of the field as input. It has been noticed that the technology that has been applied has solved the many problems associated with the current technique, which requires people to work very hard separately for each stage of the agricultural process. All three agricultural tasks are carried out automatically in this setting, with no involvement from a human being required. In the proposed equipment, a seed storage tank is located at the end of the vehicle (referred to as a robot), from which the seeds and fertilizer are dispersed out onto the field. This is accomplished via the use of two Arduino UNOs and two NodeMCUs. It is implemented and tested on actual small farmland using the prototype model of the planned system that has been developed.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of FinFET Based SRAM Cells at18nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: As per the Moore’s Prediction in 1965, the transistors count on a single chip will be doubled after every 18 months. Although, current integrated circuit technologies are posing limitations to this law. Further, device feature size scaling also introduces certain limitation on CMOS technology due to occurrence of short channel effects in nano-meter regime. FinFET based devices are found to be very promising candidate in deep submicron region. This paper aims to investigate the various performance characteristics of different topologies such as 6T,7T,8T and ST10T FinFET based static random access memory (SRAM) cells at 18nm channel length. It has been observed that read power in 8T SRAM cell is significantly reduced by 2.065 times as compared to ST10T SRAM cell. The write delay of 8T SRAM cell is improved by 1.29 times as of 6T SRAM cell. This is also worth noticeable that read stability and write stability are improved by factor of 1.25 times and 1.08 times respectively as of conventional 6T SRAM cell.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of MPPT Charge Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The solar energy is the most recent research topic because it’s direct conversion to electricity. A solar charge controller is a solar battery charger that connects the solar panel(s) to the battery. Its role is to control the battery charging process so that the battery is properly charged, and most importantly, not overcharged. Modern solar charge controllers provide advanced features such as DC load terminals for lighting, ensuring that the battery system is charged precisely and efficiently. The design and study of a photovoltaic generator simulation model are presented in this paper. The main components in these systems are solar array, boost converter and load. To extract maximum power from photovoltaic generator, proper control of converter is established. The program is simulated with different parameters and the changes in output has been observed. The result shows the dynamic behavior and control performance of the photovoltaic system in the MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Cross-tied Interconnections of PV Strings to Diminish Shading Causes during Obscured Solar Environment Conditions: Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Partial shading provides substantial obstruction in the efficient utilization of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. Partial shading condition (PSCs) degrades the PV systems output. Series-parallel (SP) and Total cross-tied (TCT) configurations are utilized for investigating the performance of the PV arrays. Various performance indices like, Short-circuit current $(I_{sc})$, Open-circuit voltage $(V_{oc})$, Power and voltage at Global maximum power point (GMPP), Power loss (PL), and Fill factor (FF) are measured to show that TCT configuration is best model for removing the impacts of PSCs. Moreover, Present study based analysis proves the efficiency of the suggested method by reducing the many peaks and improving the resultant power. Research assessment productivity confirms the practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Overview of DPL, MVL, Ternary Logic And CNTFET Technology for Contribution of Efficient Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: This paper analyses various circuits in CMOS and CNTFET technology. CNTFET technology along with Multi valued logic, complementary pass transistors, ternary logic and double pass transistor logic is far better than their CMOS counter parts. Present VLSI circuit designs can be potentially improvised through such techniques and circuits. This paper provides a glimpse of recent advancements in these techniques. Circuits such as Decoders, exact multipliers, inexact multipliers and logic gates, are reviewed in both the CMOS and CNTFET with various Logics such as Ternary, DPL, MVL logic. Exact multiplier’s energy consumption is reduced upto 6 times and energy efficiency is improved upto 35 times in inexact design, studied here. CNTFET showed tremendous improvements.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Various Approaches of Sentimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: On social networking platforms, millions of people express their thoughts in the form of the text and images every day. A tweet or text present on the online social media networking sites is very useful to carry out the sentiments of the users about the products, news etc., but from these briefs and highly unstructured data sets generated with which great insights can be gained. Several organizations now use Twitter to inform the public about their services and products. An analysis is a method to evaluate the meaning of data, which is one of the fields of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and text data mining. The sentiment analysis of the unstructured data has many facets. This paper shows a comparative study of various methods and approaches to find out the sentiments from the unstructured data.

articleTitle: Design and Manufacturing of Automated Guided E-Cart for Stock Relocation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Automated Guided Carts (AGCs) is the finest technique to mechanize a capability with the elasticity of independent material transmission. These carts are perfect for conveyance and assembly line work, with nominal interruption needed. This Research paper studies different options of automated carts available in the industry for relocation and shifting of stock in warehouses and industries. Comparing different options, a solution of the devised e-cart which is suitable for small-scale businesses (warehouses, firms) for the relocation of stock is being designed and fabricated. The designed cart is semi-automated and can be controlled by a smart device via Bluetooth. All the details such as different design options all the material requirements with an assembly of the vehicle have been discussed in the Research paper. During actual experimental analysis, the design of the chassis is found efficient enough in carrying loads up to 50 kilograms with 5 KMPH speed on different terrain. The simulation analysis conducted on Autodesk Fusion 360, for stress and strain also gives satisfactory results. From the simulation analysis FOS (15), Stress (115MPa), and Strain (0.0007) were obtained.

articleTitle: Scalable Machine learning for Mushroom Dataset Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: High mycotoxin in mushrooms determines whether mushrooms are edible or toxic. In general, the distinction between foodstuffs and poisonous mushrooms is largely unknown. Each mushroom is unique in its own way. These characteristics have been described as characteristics to categorise mushrooms into two classes: edible and poisonous. Machine Learning (ML) is a system to recognize patterns which could be used in various fields which include medicine, business management, military and engineering. However, a scalable ML platform supports large dataset processing with higher speed in distributed manner. This research focuses on analysing the performance of the scalable ML classification algorithms in mushroom poisonous detection using scalable platform (i.e. Spark). At end, comparative performance analysis of baseline ML algorithms with Spark ML algorithms was conducted on the basis of various parameters viz., Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, ZOL and Kappa-statistics.

articleTitle: Enhance Data Security in Cloud Computing with Digital Signature & Hybrid Cryptographic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The proposed paper focuses on a hybrid cryptographic algorithm that aims to provide integrity & confidentiality to our sensitive data. With the use of cryptographic algorithms and a blended key exchange algorithm along with an authentication technique, verification of data can be protected while uploading it to any cloud platform. The cloud computing boom is ultimately on the pinnacle because of the pandemic that forces corporations to operate virtually and people to stay indoors for their work from home. Cloud computing offers advantages like on-demand services, shared hardware and software, but also involves storing data at unknown place. So they are sometimes susceptible to leaks of data or other malicious internet attacks, making it a serious worry for enterprises all over the world. The objective of this paper is to explore the different algorithms utilised for security, performance and finally to identify the most adequate and efficient combination. The emphasis is on finding the practical consequences of the presented results and not merely on theoretical principles.

articleTitle: Validation of Clustering Based Framework Using Unsupervised Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: K-Means algorithm of clustering is reflected in a more influential and widespread concept of mining in the research community. But, in spite of its acceptance, this method has few limitations associated with initialization problem of centroids to lead to surprise converge. Therefore, it is responsible for various shapes of the cluster and also affects the outlier. But the main problem of its method is that it is not capable to manage the huge dataset. In this paper, we have discussed how to overcome the limitations, where their performance is a measure based on experimental analysis by using the iris data set. In this paper, we proposed an efficient framework data mining using machine learning unsupervised technique k-means, this framework system which is implemented with MATLAB software, and NCSS 2021, SPSS tools for simulation to assess the training of iris, and heart disease datasets to measure the validity of clusters. Furthermore, proposed concept leads to the various directions of studies and exploration for research.

articleTitle: Design and Computational Analysis of the modified Exhaust System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The exhaust system is of one the main components in the vehicles, today in the market scenario, Automobiles are coming with an exhaust system that is either producing a lot of noise or they are producing less power in the engine. The cost of customization of the exhaust system is too high and this is not affordable to many automobile enthusiasts. In the present study, the new design is introduced which will not only reduce the noise coming from the engine but will also help to increase the power output of the engine, It will also keep a check on the direct nature of noise with respect to the power output. The new proposed muffler design comes with a noise reduction system and also increases the power of the engine. This muffler is of baffle design nature and with a special material that can help in reducing the noise, By the use of this muffler system, not only noise will be reduced but also it is safe to the environment and also safer to the person who is dealing with it. In future this design can possibly be used in the automobile for getting the best out of it. The modified exhaust design is then examined in detail by CFD analysis etc.

articleTitle: Static Random-Access Memory using Twelve Transistors Sleep Mode Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Presently, CMOS circuit fabricated at nano scale have power dissipation mainly due to leakage current. This work mainly shows on the methods to reduce power dissipation in static and dynamic mode. Different approaches have been used previously to minimize the effect of leakage current. The proposed circuit in this paper reduces the power dissipation and delay. This proposed SRAM is designed using twelve transistors (12T) sleep mode circuit. Standard 6T SRAM cannot provide reduced delay and sub-threshold operation. A ten transistor (10T) design is also compared for the delay and power dissipation. The proposed design uses a sleep transistor circuit. The main purpose of this design is to provide a lower delay in read and write mode, reduce leakage power in cutoff mode and keep the logic state in park mode. The results of SRAM with twelve transistors (12T) sleep mode circuit show that static power dissipation is comparable, whereas dynamic power is lowest i.e. 417.87nW and reduced delay 232.59pS in comparison to other SRAM designs discussed in this paper. This SRAM is implemented using the Mentor Graphics simulation tool. Design architect modeled with Mentor Graphics Pyxis Schematic and Analysis is done using ELDO-net Simulator at 1.8V supply voltage using technology node of 180nm.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Silt Erosion in Hydro Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: As it is well known that hydro turbine in a hydro power plant constitutes of one of the most important component and if it is not functioning properly or out of order and maintenance is required than the plant suffers a huge loss in its capacity of power generation which is itself a source of revenue for it and thereby suffering correspondingly huge economic losses. Moreover even one percent loss in efficiency of the turbine due to silt erosion/ cavitations is responsible for huge economic losses and revenue to a utility. In this paper, cost analysis is carried out for the turbines affected due to erosion based on energy generation and maintenance with the help of the cost of repair and maintenance obtained from various turbine manufacturers. A methodology is evolved to analyze the economics of hydro turbines under such conditions, which may be helpful for the turbine manufacturers to do the comparative analysis that whether to go for preventive measures for turbine erosion or to go for maintenance of turbines with a point of view of cost.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 12-bit Vedic Multiplier using Optimized Decoder-based Adder
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: A Multiplier is one of the arithmetic circuits which plays a major role in many computational systems-based real-time applications. The responsibility of power consumption in the system greatly depends on the power consumption of its multiplier. In this work, slice LUT’s, slices, IOB, delay, and power of the proposed 3x3 bit, 6x6 bit, and 12x12 bit novel decoder based Vedic multiplier using “Urdhva Tiryakbhayam” sutra are calculated and compared with the conventional multiplier. The simulation and synthesis of the proposed 3x3 bit, 6x6 bit, and 12x12 bit multiplier are performed using Artex-7 on Xilinx Vivado. The comparative study of the proposed Vedic multiplier with the existing Vedic multiplier exhibits a significant improvement in terms of resource utilization.

articleTitle: A Translator for Indian Sign Boards to English using Tesseract and SEQ2SEQ Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Language translator for Indian language to English have been developed and it have proven to a challenging domain due to large combination of character in Indic scripts such as Tamil, Kannada and Hindi. In this paper we propose a system which captures Indian printed character and translates it into English, we have discussed the various method and machine learning model that was used to build this system with an accuracy of 87%.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Image Captioning Models: A Critical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The main goal of image captioning is to produce moat appropriate caption for any image. It is required to find out objects in a picture, their connection and also some hidden features which might be not present in a picture. When the recognition is done, our succeeding step is to produce the most suitable, accurate and short description for a picture which must be grammatically correct. Computer vision concept is used for recognition of objects and description is generated by methods of natural image processing. Sometimes it is not easy for a machine to emulate exactly like human brain or thinking like that. However, in this field researches have shown their great achievements. By using deep learning algorithms like CNN and RNN, we are capable enough to deal with such type of problems. In intelligent control system and IOT based devices this is mostly used. In this research paper, we are introducing distinct models of picture description like retrieval based, template based or deep learning based and distinct evaluation methods also.

articleTitle: Design of Microfluidic Flow Sensor to Detect Cancer by Analyzing CEA Molecule Concentration in Blood Serum
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: CEA (carcinoembryonic Antigen) concentration based biosensor is designed in the FEM tool for the suitable recognition of colon cancer disease. The result of specific binding was analyzed to optimize the design of the biosensor. To detect cancer disease in the early stage the biosensor array matrix able to recognize the specific analyte in low concentration target molecules with a low volume sample is more challenging. We build a Multiphysics computational model to study the CEA molecule concentrations to estimate the presence of cancer cells in the blood. A Dielectro-phorosis based microfluidic channel is designed to separate the serum and other cells from the blood using p-DEP. The CEA molecules in serum flow through the micro pillar matrix. We examined how design influences the detection of disease by modifying surface parameters like flow velocity, the spacing between pillars, and pillar diameter.

articleTitle: Computational Investigations on Non-Circular Ducts Used for Large Scale Cooling Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: A computational investigation that predict thermal and fluidic characteristics of flow of liquid nitrogen at the temperature of 62.3 K and 2 bar in non-circular ducts as rectangular, square and equilateral triangular cross sections. b/a ratio of rectangular duct ranging from 0.2-0.5 and a constant length of 1.275 m. This study shows the effects of increasing Reynolds number (10000-100000) over the wide range of cross sectional areas of the three non-circular ducts. The flow of liquid nitrogen in the ducts was considered as incompressible flow and fully turbulent. The effects of Nusselt number and pumping power over the wide range of Reynolds number were observed. The results show that, when Reynolds number increases, Nusselt number and required pumping power increases.

articleTitle: Movie Reviews Sentiment Analysis through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is one of the widely used methods to predict reviews provided by us and a lot more emotions through texts and words. A huge load of AI techniques has been performed to procure proper gauges about the data. Long stretch dependence and max pooling is not considered by the classifier. To further develop assumptions using these features, in this paper we cluster surveys utilizing Deep learning methods. We utilize Neural Network and Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Network to get the highest point of accuracy with fewer misfortune and with a smaller registering time.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Organic p-type and n-type Material based Thin-Film Transistors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: This paper discusses the possibility of organic circuit design, therefore, this paper, initially begins with organic thin-film transistors (OTFTs) independent performance analysis using Atlas Silvaco 2-D device simulator. Subsequently, performance is compared with experimental reported performance parameters. Where, current-voltage (I-V) characteristics of each p/n device are investigated and observed the average error of 0.8%, and 4.3% for threshold voltage and mobility, respectively. The performance of p-type and n-type material-based devices is compared to validate. In addition to this, CuPc, pentacene, $\mathrm{C}_{8}\mathrm{B}\mathrm{T}\mathrm{B}\mathrm{T}, \mathrm{F}_{16}\mathrm{C}\mathrm{u}\mathrm{P}\mathrm{c}, \mathrm{C}_{60}$, and $\mathrm{Z}\mathrm{n}\mathrm{O}$ material-based devices are discussed using p/n type material combinations to observe the impact of different materials and configurations. Analytical outcomes have also been provided for switching threshold and propagation delay validate the simulation of the devices. The identified high-performance n-type and p-type devices are further used the design of organic flexible digital circuits a lower cost.

articleTitle: Multiple Face Detection and Attendance System Using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Facial detection and recognition is an important field in computer vision, it attracts increasing interest because of the multiple applications that result from it. In this context, the strategies that supported machine learning that permits a machine to evolve through a learning method has been used, and it also perform tasks that area unit troublesome or not possible to fill a lot of standards algorithmic means that. Within the commencement, the face detection algorithmic program is employed to extract the faces from each video frames and to get the face information. Within the second step, filtering and preprocessing area unit applied to the face pictures obtained within the previous step. Within the third step, a set of machine learning algorithms area unit trained exploitation as input file the faces obtained within the previous step. Haarcascade classifier is employed each for choice, and for learning, that may be a sturdy classifier with a cascade classification. Finally, classified faces obtained from frames (test videos). The obtained result shows the suitableness of this system for analyzing immense assortment of video wherever previous face labels aren’t accessible.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study based on Human Facial Images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The human’s facial image is a cumbersome research topic in computer vision or digital image processing. This paper tried to estimate the human gender and age that is too robust for different external environments. It gives an overview of facial recognition. There are the major applications as law enforcement, security, simulation on various areas to prevent the environmental condition. The common issues are occlusion, illumination, pose, imaging condition, facial expressions along with the facial features. More recently, the Convolution Neural Network (CNN) is a mostly used model to explore the current application background. The improved structure and learning method of the CNN network gives better performance and also the results are to be evaluated. The model predicts its human age and gender to classify the facial images.

articleTitle: Post Disaster Power Distribution using Robotic Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The paper aims to design mobile microgrids with the help of robotics technology. Microgrids refers to those group of electricity sources that in normal conditions work while being connected to synchronous grids but in adverse conditions switch to autonomous way. In areas where it is difficult for humans to work, such autonomous microgrids can be used. To monitor the power system to checks its reliability, aging status, and faults a large amount of data is to be processed using sensors, signal processing, robotics. Thus, by involving the use of robotics in power system monitoring, these functions and tasks can be performed faster. Energy consumption can also be reduced by the use of mobile robots. The use of robotics in a complicated, hazardous environment is an economic approach. The paper focuses on different software & hardware being used to design the architecture of microgrids. Thus, by integrating different components a feasible design of the system is obtained that can be used in dynamic environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Driver Drowsiness Detection System with OpenCV & Keras
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Nowadays, transport facility is a basic component of living. While driving, any one of us can come across an accident, that may be due to lack of sleep, uneven physical health, or prolonged travelling. The lack of sleep or any unfair condition deviates from a higher chance of accidents. The weakness or sluggishness are among the major causes for road accidents. Due to this, there is a higher number of accidents annually across the globe. There have been several vehicle’s accidents across the globe in recent years. Several vehicles are running over the road day and night. Due to continuous travelling, it becomes obvious to get tired and the same can be measured in terms of drowsiness. Due to lack of sleep, it becomes very dangerous to drive. Hence, it is an urgent need to catch the fatigue nature of the motorist to protect his survival as well as of others. Driver Drowsiness Detection System is the main target of this paper. This model captures images of the driver in real time without stopping and measures the state of the driver’s eyes using particular algorithms. Though there are several other methods to do the same task this method is completely disconnected from the driver as it does not affect the driver in any manner. For recognizing somnolence, the stopping score of the eyes is measured and if it goes beyond a given score then one is considered sleepy and in-that case, an alarm is raised by the system immediately.

articleTitle: An Insight into Various Techniques in CNTFET on Full Adder and Gates for Efficient Outputs
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Carbon Nanotube Field Effect Transistor technology is replacing CMOS technology to fulfil requirements of efficient circuits. This paper reviews the minority based approximate imprecise full adder in CNTFET technology, on its VTC and transient response. Analysis of approximate adder in terms of power and delay for error-resilient applications is done. Superiority of approximation technique in multi-bit inexact adders is verified for de-noising image applications. Here approximate full adder is analysed to be better for error tolerant applications. CNTFET based 7-input minority gate found to be here to be better than existing technologies. Hence, this review will be a reference for researchers.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of FinFET based 10T SRAM Cell for Low Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Portable gadgets such as mobile phones and laptops are in high demand, and they require increased performance as well as lower power dissipation. Low power memory circuits are frequently used in these gadgets to maintain the backup batteries. In this regard, a new 10T static random access memory (SRAM) cell with increased stability, medium throughput, and lower power consumption has been built and evaluated. The Cadence virtuoso tool was used to evaluate the 18nm technology node’s predicted topology. The read decoupling approach is employed in the proposed 10T cell to improve read stability, while leakage power is reduced by stacking transistors in the core latch. The read/write power dissipation in a 10T Memory cell is 63.6 percent / 39.9 percent lower than in a normal 6T Memory cell. In comparison to a conventional 6T SRAM cell, read/write reliability is enhanced by 1.91/1.53 times. Furthermore, when compared to a normal 6T SRAM cell, read access latency is reduced by 1.2 times. However, the suggested 10T SRAM cell’s write latency is 1.6 times that of a typical 6T Memory cell.

articleTitle: FEM Based Modelling of Electronic chip cooling using Heat Sink
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: In portable electronic industries the thermal management of microelectronics is most important and it thresholds in high performance. As the energy density and heat dissipation in electronic equipment increased, fluid cooling techniques were made more necessary for efficient thermal management. Liquid cooling became increasingly necessary to keep the Chip temperatures acceptable due to increasing power density of microelectronic modules. When an inefficient cooling approach is applied particularly for high-performance computing processors (HPC), increases temperature and failure rate. Heat sinks with corrugated fins have been developed for the effective cooling of integrated large-scale circuits (LSIC). The PCM heat sinks are used to store the heat dissipated from electronics. The electronic components delay the peak temperature so that release and store energy during the off period. An analytical model of the flow and heat transfer in microchannel heat sinks is also presented.

articleTitle: The Impact and Potential of Block chain Applications Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The Block chain is a course of action of recording information to such an extent that makes it irritating or hard to alter, slash, or swindle the system. In blockchain decentralized amend the proceedings that could be used to indicate, join up also send wide scope of agreement to various social affairs in association. The scope of block chain applications stretches out to open and public administrations including wellbeing, financial, automotive, Internet of Things (IoT) and risk management. This paper presents a thorough outline on blockchain innovation. Lately, block chain innovation has become extremely stylish and infiltrated various areas, generally because of the crypto currencies determination of rotator for the particular sort of suspension needs some fundamental information.

articleTitle: Identification of Coronavirus & Pneumonia from Chest x-ray Scans using Deep Multilayered CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Recently, COVID-19 disease carried out by the SARS-CoV-2 virus appeared as a pandemic across the world. The traditional diagnostic techniques are facing a hard time detecting the virus efficiently at an early stage. In this context, chest x-ray scans can be useful for diagnostic prediction. Therefore, in this paper, a deep multi-layered convolution neural network has been proposed to analyze the chest x-ray scans effectively for detecting COVID-19 and pneumonia accurately. The proposed approach has been applied on multiple benchmark datasets and the experimental results define the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: License Plate Detection by Edge Detection Algorithm and Smart Exposition with IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Vehicles are prime objects in transport systems. Furthermore, Number plates are identification keys for vehicles. License plate detection systems are used at various places nowadays like traffic management authority; they use this system to identify the person who violates the traffic rule and then sends the challan to that particular person, toll way authority uses this system to scan the vehicle number plate automatically and then allow them to enter the road with the pay slip, and parking areas uses this to make incoming and outgoing management feasible. Concept of optical character recognition and image processing is used in license number plate detection systems. Four main digital image processing steps involved in this system, image acquisition, pre-processing of acquired image, extraction of number plate region, segmentation and character recognition. Additionally In past explores SOBEL Edge detection technique was utilized to separate the number plate segment from picture. This algorithm does not produce very efficient results in case of a blur image (due to high intensity of light). At the time of segmentation morphological operation causes disfigurement in characters. This paper focuses on canny edge detection algorithms to automatically detect the license vehicle number plates in INDIA. Gathering successive pictures from different areas is a draggy task utilizing IOT framework to gather pictures. The IOT system can be integrated with the camera or circuit system which clicks the picture of the vehicle and this system sends these pictures to the database from where this picture can be further processed easily.

articleTitle: Application to Filter Unwanted Messages from OSN User Walls
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: In the 21st century, the capacity to manage the contents published on their own space and to evade that undesirable substance from being shown is the significant issue faced by the clients of Online social networks (OSN). Till now OSNs give the limited quantity of help to this prerequisite. To correct that, in this paper, an application permitting the clients of the OSN to have immediate power on the contents and remarks posted on their dividers is proposed.

articleTitle: Video To Braille Transcription For Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Visual disability is a global issue. The number of visually impaired people is estimated to be around 285 million in the world. Out of which 246 million people have poor vision and 39 million are completely blind. The statistics of visually impaired people. Ninety percent of this population lives in developing countries. The difficulties faced by them in using the latest technologies and how they dealt with these are largely unknown and under-explored, especially in the developing world. Availability of video to Braille transcription anytime, anywhere, provides a potentially life-changing opportunity for the visually challenged to improve their communication capability. We are introducing software for hearing and visually impaired people to transcribe video to printed Braille scripts. It is evident that implementation of such a system for visually handicapped people with a productive method of Real-time speech to Braille transcription, text to speech, text to Braille, video to Braille conversion, work on commands with flexibility will be of great use

articleTitle: Evaluating Solar Flux-Temperature Distribution in the STCR Cavity- A SolTrace-CFD approach
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The solar assisted thermochemical H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> O/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>- splitting process is practiced for H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/CO production. Among the many solar thermochemical processes, the CeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> catalyst-based H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> O-splitting cycle is one of the most favorable for solar fuel generation. The conceptual design and optical analysis of the Reticulated Porous Ceria (RPC) solar thermochemical cavity reactor (STCR) to attain the optimal conditions (uniform solar flux distribution) and to achieve the favorable temperature for the reduction step has been presented. STCR is a modified geometry made from cylindrical and hemispherical shapes. The optical analysis has been carried out by considering two cases; (1) focal point is at aperture (x = 0) and (2) focal point is 20 mm inside the STCR (x = -20 mm). Results show that the case-1 with 4 mrad S.E was more uniform. Further, the case-1 with 2 mrad S.E generates 33% greater solar flux value in comparison to 4 mard S.E but the highest temperature value was achieved for the 4 mrad S.E. The focal point located inside the reactor cavity yields lower heat flux as compared to the focal point at the aperture. The catalyst temperature in the radial direction with 4 mrad S.E was higher in comparison to the 2 mrad S.E. However, in case-2, the catalyst temperature with 2 mrad S.E is higher as compared to the 4 mrad S.E in radial direction. The catalyst temperature in the axial direction, as well as the reactor cavity temperature along the centerline for case-1 with 4 mrad S.E, is the highest.

articleTitle: Traffic Congestion Control System based on Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: At the point when we dissect present Traffic Light System (TLS), at that point we recognize that there is parcel of restriction on that framework. Traffic congestion arises when a bulk of traffic or average fragmented generates demand for area larger than the existing road size. There are various explicit conditions which cause or bother congestion of traffic at junction point; a large portion of them lessen the limit of a street at a given point or over a specific length, or increment the quantity of vehicles needed for a given volume of individuals or products. This Present Structure isn’t on real time basis. This System are based on microcontroller and microchip. These TLS have limits since it utilizes the pre-characterized equipment, which is operational as per the program that doesn’t have the adaptability of alteration on constant premise. Because of the static time periods, orange and red signals the halt time is more and automobile exploit more fuel. To compel traffic signal framework all the more methodical, we exploit the rise of new procedure called as “traffic gridlock control framework dependent on microcontroller”. This makes the usage of Sensor Networks close by Embedded Technology. This venture additionally incorporates examining traffic of every along the signs and giving time-frame to gleam the individual light. For that diligence, we use sensor-based traffic signal framework. The controls of yellow, green, red sign depend on static timing. The timings of red, green lights at each crossing of will be smartly settled dependent on the density of vehicle present on every nearby adjacent road. Subsequently, it is improved traffic and prevent traffic congestions.

articleTitle: Nano Ballot Box: A Low Power, Thermal Resistant FPGA Based Electronic Voting Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The traditional Ballot box voting system was very time-consuming and prone to mistake. So, to address this issue, EVM was created. E-voting is an election technology that allows voters to cast a secret ballot that is then electronically tallied. Votes are saved so that they can be re-counted if necessary. Since the 1960s, electronic voting (e-voting) systems have been in use. When compared to alternative voting methods, e-voting has several advantages. Electronic Voting Machine (EVM) polling is a simple, safe, and secure approach that takes up very little of our time. Due to the lack of a VHDL FPGA implementation of an Electronic Voting Machine, we present an efficient, transparent, and secure FPGA implementation of an EVM using VHDL in this article. In such a system power dissipation is typically seen as a hardware issue. It may, however, be successfully remedied by implementing power-saving measures in both hardware and software. Various scaling strategies are also employed to achieve the best results. The frequency, temperature, and voltage are scaled without requiring extra hardware resources from the processing system’s programmable logic. Among LVCMOS, we are utilizing the most energy-efficient I/O standard. To avoid transmission line reflection, and I/O standard is utilized to match the impedance of the transmission line, port impedance, and memory impedance. As a consequence of this article, a low power consumption and thermal resistant voting machine based on FPGA is introduced.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of a High Gain and Low Noise Figure 90 nm CMOS LNA Using Noise Cancellation Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: This paper demonstrate the designing of inductorless low-noise amplifier (LNA) in 90nm CMOS (Complementary metal oxide semiconductor) technology. Two paths are introduced in this LNA, one is common source (CS) and the other is common gate (CG). Power gain is realized by CS path and input matching is achieved by CG path. The implementation of noise cancellation technique provides and enhancement in the Noise Figure (NF). Here S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> is negative for the entire band and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> is positive for the entire band. S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> varies from −8 to −13.8dB and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> varies from 4 to 10.5 dB in the frequency range of 0–2.5 GHz. At 2.5 GHz, the minimum NF value is 3 dB.

articleTitle: A Data Hiding Technique for Digital videos using Entropy based Blocks Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The technique of hiding knowledge in certain details is steganography. One of the main trends of computer infrastructure and connectivity following the advent of the Internet has been cyber protection and information security. It is required to hide valuable information like passwords, bank details and other personal document. In this perspective a new algorithm is proposed to make message more secure. In which firstly random frames are selected by using key and then random macro blocks are selected. The macro blocks with high entropy have chosen to hide the data in it. In this experiment author explains the effect of noise on Steganography video with the help of PSNR, MSE & BER.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Cache Memory Design for Single Bit Architecture for IoT Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: This paper describes the performance analysis of cache memory design for single-bit architecture. Single Bit Architecture comprised of a circuit of write driver, six transistors static random access memory cell, and sense amplifiers such as charge transfer differential sense amplifier and current latch sense amplifier. Apart from it, different parameters of architecture such as consumption of power and number of transistors have been analyzed at different values of resistance. The conclusion arises that single-bit six transistors static random access memory cell current latch sense amplifier architecture consumes 43.29$\mu$W of power with 33 transistors. This analysis has done using a cadence tool at 90$\eta$m technology at V$_{\mathbf{DD}}=$ 1.2V.

articleTitle: A Framework for Automatic Fake Content Identification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Fake news emerged as a challenge for society now a day. Easy accessibility and low cost to the internet makes the fake news propagation task easy. In the Covid-19 pandemic situation, it is required to reduce the proliferation of misleading content to reduce its severe impact. Many existing works are based on lexico-syntactic features using a small training sample size. To address this issue, this study used the Gossip-cop dataset for evaluation. Various supervised techniques of the ML model and advanced deep learning techniques are implemented for intense research. Dataset is crawled from Gossipcop fact-checking websites. The dataset consists of 4,947fake news with text and 16,694 real news. The result of these algorithms helps in differentiating false content from reliable news and improved the accuracy achieved using existing techniques.

articleTitle: Study of Making Efficient Circuits Using DG, TG, GAA Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: On the nano scale it becomes a great challenge of using CMOS technology because of the leakage current and leakage power. This paper is the comparative study of latest researches on CNTFET technology with ternary logic with DG, TG cntfet. Advantages of double gate, tri gate and GAA cntfet circuits are discussed. CNTFET shows better results due to very high speed charge carriers, high signal to noise value, ballistic transport and smaller size. Simple, positive, negative inverters in CNTFET are discussed and found better.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Methods Used for Diagnosis of Diabetic Retinopathy Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: India is the world’s second most populated country this fact also contributes to the verity that why India is known as the Diabetes capital of the world. According to IDF (or International Diabetic Federation), on an average 463 million people around the globe are suffering from diabetes out of which 77 million alone resides in India. By scientists around the world it is also estimated that India will reach a benchmark of 134 million diabetes cases, just the double amount it is now by next 25 years. In India diabetes, is popularly known as “sugar” or “sugar level”. And several studies have concluded a point that basically “Type 2” diabetes is more common in India, which causes Indians a greater risk towards “Diabetic Retinopathy (or popularly known as DR)”. DR is a medical condition which arises in a person if he/she is a patient of diabetes for at least 10 years. Although in its earlier stage, DR can be cured under the supervision of the doctor, but if a person neglects the warnings in its initial stages, then this disease becomes uncontrollable in its later stages even leading to the vision impairment by permanently destroying the retinal vessels of the patient’s eye. This research paper directs towards the different machine learning models that can be used in the field of medical science for early detection of DR which can help to detect this disease at the initial stage using Fundus images of patients and can further help for the betterment of our society, nation and the overall world.

articleTitle: Implementation of CODAS MCDM Method for the Selection of Suitable Cutting Fluid
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Due to the friction between the clearing face of the tool and the workpiece, high temperature is raised during the metal-cutting operations. Plastic deformation occurs as well as temperature rises due to the heat generation in both workpiece and tool, resulting in the reduction of tool life. The machined surface will also become rougher, and the propensity for built-up edges to shape will increase. As a result, choosing the right cutting fluid is critical as well as important during the machining process. This article provides an in-depth study of a cutting fluid selection problem using a very underutilized CODAS MCDM during cylindrical grinding operation. The simplicity and user-friendly nature of CODAS method motivates the authors to use it for this specific analysis. The aim of this article is to propose the best cutting fluid among four available alternatives on the basis of eight essential parameters. The final findings indicate that Alternative 4 and Alternative 1 are the best and worst cutting fluid respectively. The current rankings are compared to previously proposed rankings derived using various MCDM tools. The outcomes from this present analysis using CODAS shows an excellent correlation with those results obtained by previous researchers. The robustness of the CODAS MCDM is also justified as well as validated through sensitivity analysis.

articleTitle: Prototype of Operating A Vehicle Using Arduino Micro-Controller With Wireless Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: This research primarily represents the structure setup and programming composition of the radio receiver vehicle operation. Hardware program model employing standard model approaches, along with operating ARDUINO UNO and Nano section to be the primary authority part, ultrasonic sensor element, PIR, RF unit, Sim-card Unit, motor driver section as the essential sections; software growth and composition purposes ARDUINO programming to compose the full program. The vehicle uses motor drive unit L-298N as the motor driver for providing the dragging force for the vehicle parts. The Sim-card component of the vehicle will produce the venue of the vehicle and likewise will be controlled to implement data on the server. The ultrasonic sensor of the vehicle will estimate the distance of the hindrances. The PIR sensor of the vehicle will anticipate the warmth near it. The incidents in the appearance of figures will be uploaded by a sim-card section on the server.

articleTitle: Smart Home Energy Management System Under Dynamic pricing for developing countries using Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Smart home energy management systems (SHEMS) have become widely popular to reduce a residential load profile’s cost and energy consumption. The optimal design of SHEMS is achieved with various meta-heuristic optimization techniques such as genetic algorithm (GA), particle swarm optimization (PSO) etc. In this paper, PSO has been utilized to execute and estimate the optimum solution analytically for a developing country’s general load profile. These algorithmic optimization techniques help find the optimal solution called the fitness function for continuous and differentiable functions. The proposed formulation has been solved on a test system using PSO in a MATLAB environment. The result obtained using the PSO technique demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed formulation. Furthermore, the binary particle swarm optimization BPSO performed better in reducing energy consumption and thus reduced cost up to thirty-nine per cent (39%) in the obtained results.

Author Keywords: Smart Homes. Internet of Things IoT

articleTitle: Effective Behavioural Analysis using Polystore Data Catalog and Intelligent Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: This paper aims to design and implement an application usage behaviour analytics system to produce dynamic bundles personalized to each customer. A H2O Deep Learning model was first built to predict the list of products that are most likely to be reordered by each customer, on the basis of which bundle combinations were framed. The model was found to have an accuracy score of 83.04, a precision score of 84.7 and a recall score of 96.31. The products comprising each customer’s bundle were determined by a 3:1 ratio of products that the customer is most expected to purchase to the products that are less popular. This implementation starts with building a data lineage and catalog from multiple data sources with persistent data collected from transactions and product catalogs which was then used to identify, model, analyze behavioral patterns and collect insights in order to build the prediction model. This method of recommendation attempts to solve the cold-start effect of new products and to eliminate the popularity bias in bundle recommendation systems by producing personalized dynamic bundles in such a way that it improves the sales of unpopular products while also contributing to overall customer satisfaction. The technical stack that was used for implementing this idea includes Apache Spark, Mongodb Atlas and Apache H2O.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on 6G Networks: Key Technologies and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: While fifth generation (5G) systems are being deployed worldwide from 2020, there is already a major interest in beyond 5G i.e. Sixth generation of wireless communication systems. Hence, it is envisioned that 6G networks will provide new communication services, network capacity, and ultra-low latency communications. In this paper, first, the Vision and requirement of 6G networks is discussed. Then, the potential key enabling technologies for 6G networks are presented. In particular, we will focus on Terahertz communication technologies, intelligent surfaces, Visible light communications and Index modulation. Finally, several challenges for future 6G networks and potential future directions are presented.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Vortex Bladeless an Attachable Fin that Harvest Energy Using Piezoelectric Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: Vortex is a bladeless wind turbine that harvests electricity. It is extracted from the turbine's unlikely vibrations, which constantly add stress and strain to the piezoelectric content, transforming the vibratory energy into electrical energy. This concept attempts to solve the challenge that the traditional generator has. Installing piezoelectric material in the turbine for proper use of vibrational energy to collect electricity is how Vortex's bladeless energy harvesting technology generates more energy. This system has a strong benefit in that it is a unit composite structure that is easy to move and uses less room for assembly. Since this wind turbine does not need a bearing or gear for installation, maintenance is limited and the turbine's lifetime is improved. The expandable fins are attached to this turbine to increase or decrease the surface area of the turbine according to the wind direction, as well as to help sustain the high degree of vibration achieved at low wind speeds. The aim of adding the extra expandable fins to the turbine was to boost the performance of energy harvesting at very low wind speeds while still making the system lightweight than current turbines of the same diameter. The mass of the turbine in this configuration is approximately half that of a typical turbine of comparable width and length.

articleTitle: An integrated approach of Taguchi - Grey Relational Analysis technique to optimize the drill process factors in the machining of Glass Fiber Centered Polymer Composite Laminates
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: The technical research paper presented here is paying attention on optimizing the drill process factors in the hole making the process of Glass Fiber Centered Polymer Composite (GFCPC) laminates. Drill spindle speed, drill feed rate, and drill diameter are the three input process factors considered, with three levels of each factor. The drill flank wear and the surface roughness of the drilled hole are considered to be the two response factors to be analyzed and optimized. Taguchi’s design of experiments concept is adopted to set up the optimized experimental design. The combination of Taguchi Analysis and Gray Relational Analysis (GRA) is employed to the multi response experimental data collected for drill flank wear as well as surface roughness. The GRA converted multi-response characteristic into single performance characteristic by generating Grey Relation Grades (GRG). The analysis showed that, a spindle speed of 1200rpm, drill feed of 0. 2mm/rev, and 6mm drill diameter will minimize both drill flank wear and surface roughness. Post analysis of GRG with respect to the Analysis of variance (ANOVA) technique applied to the average GRG values inferred that drill diameter has highest significance (46.97%), trailed by the drill feed rate (20.37%) and drill spindle speed (16.10%) on GRG. Confirmation tests performed to verify the validity of the optimization of GRG showed an improvement of 6.9% in the experimental GRG values.

articleTitle: Fake News Propagation in the era of Covid-19-Tracing and Combating Fake News using Block Chain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: News at the times of Covid-19 poses the threat to the health industry. This paper finds the study to understand the features and social sites that propagates fake news without any restriction. The analysis of this fake news has came to the conclusion that it has broadly effected the health, political, entertainment and religious themes. The health related fake news during pandemic tops the chart. The problem of “fake news” has become the topic of concern and it plays with the sentiments of the people. This problem has spread rapidly during the pandemic due the easy accessibility of social sites. In this paper we are discussing the overview of fake news and using block chain technology and its framework which has served as an efficient tool to combat the spread of fake news and how the various features of fake news have design issues and how it is tackled.

articleTitle: A Digitalization Model Structure for Sustainable and Enhanced Profitability in Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Simulation, Automation & Smart Manufacturing (SASM)
abstract: A Digitalization Model Structure (DMS) for industry 4.0 operations that utilizes concepts of systems analysis coupled with valuation of outputs is presented here. The conceptual model and associated data analytics should allow optimization of any industrial operation, identify incremental needs for innovation and development, and appropriate approaches for their implementation to achieve desired results with a good understanding of return on incremental investments. It considers interactions among all subsystems of an industrial system to identify needs for improvements and evaluations of alternate solutions. The feasibility of machine learning and artificial intelligence and their impacts on profitability can also be assessed. Initially, the data gathered should allow for more effective planning of unit operations based on deterministic (average) values but as more data are analysed, the model could be used for stochastic planning and profitability modelling. The authors illustrate proposed use of the model with an example for open-pit coal mining operations.
